title: The Thunder Realm and a trip home
summary: The academy raises memorial tablets for the fallen, including Su Ling'er, and Tai Cang laments the losses, the equal-for-all philosophy that deters geniuses, and the long-sealed North Heaven Gate; Shen Cangsheng and the students demand he open it. The top ten of the Heavenly Ranking go into the North Heaven Gate for half a year, while Lord Beiming takes Mu Chen for three months of body tempering in the Thunder Realm, telling him the North Heaven Continent may be a piece on someone's chessboard. Mu Chen comes out with the Mid-Tier Four-Striped Thunder Body and learns of the Mirror of Judgment, which created the Spiritual Land and is used at the competition's quarterfinals. Ling Xi trains him for the other three months, returning the Yin volume of the Great Buddha Art so he can join both halves, and he accepts her as a sister; she borrows the Spirit Veil Chess from Tai Cang to hide it from his mother's clansmen. Luo Li, who trains in a pressure pool alongside Su Xuan, leaves early to meet him. Mu Chen brings Luo Li home to Mu Realm, tells Mu Feng he saw his mother, and hears that Mu Feng has unified the North Spiritual Territory into the Northern Spiritual Alliance and that Tan Qingshan and Liu Yang have been accepted by the academy.
